[attribute-link-type]
=== `@link-type` Type of Link (for a Related Object)

How a <<element-related-object,`<related-object>`>> element is related to the current standards document, for example, a Technical Report concerning the standard.

#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-related-object,`<related-object>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| Text, numbers, or special characters| The type of relationship between the related object and the current standards 
                        document.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
